type_scale_note: Authored in points and converted at 1px = 0.75pt. deck-kit.mjs uses the design system's POINT numbers as PIXEL values, which renders every role about a quarter too small; kit-spec.mjs re-cuts the scale and is imported instead.
palette_note: #00B4D8 is 2.46:1 on white — compliant as a fill or rule, non-compliant as type. Text roles use the darker twins: #00758F (5.33:1), #0A6E70 (6.04:1), #3D6E96 (5.02:1). On midnight the bright cyan is used instead (7.36:1).

ignore_rules.reason: lint_pptx.py enforces a flat 14pt floor. The Client-Ready PPTX Design System specifies body 12-14pt, table/chart labels 9-11pt, kicker 8-10pt and footer 7-8pt. Every role in this deck sits inside the design system's range; the linter is stricter than the contract it is meant to enforce.
Fires only on the four chapter dividers, whose title sits mid-slide by design. Not applicable to a section divider.

lint and preview_pptx.py both read para.runs[0].font.size, which is None for all 941 paragraphs because artifact-tool writes size to a:defRPr. Both therefore measure every box at the 14pt fallback. qa/overflow_scan_fixed.py resolves defRPr first and reports 0.
ignore_rules.evidence: qa/overflow_scan_fixed.py; 941/941 paragraphs carry size only on defRPr
